content.name: Nathan Kowalski
content.title: UX Designer II
content.summary: UX designer with nine years designing B2B logistics software, consumer health apps and payment tools in Seattle. Runs research and interaction design for a merchant onboarding flow used by 30,000 small businesses, where my redesign raised completion from 58% to 74%.

experience.title: UX Designer
bullets: Designed dispatcher and warehouse screens for a route-planning product used by about 400 freight companies.
Ran 25 contextual inquiry sessions in warehouses, which reshaped the scan-and-load workflow around gloved, one-handed use.
Reduced the average time to build a delivery route from 11 minutes to 7 by consolidating three setup screens into one.

experience.title: Product Designer
bullets: Owned the medication reminder and refill experience in an iOS and Android app with 600,000 monthly users.
Partnered with a clinical advisor to design dosage schedules that patients could set up without help, cutting support tickets by 27%.
Built the first shared component library in Figma, adopted by four product squads.
Audited the app against WCAG 2.1 AA and fixed 40-plus contrast, focus and screen reader issues with engineering.

experience.title: UX Designer II
bullets: Lead research and interaction design for merchant onboarding, identity verification and first payout.
Redesigned the onboarding flow after 18 usability sessions, increasing completion from 58% to 74%.
Mentor two associate designers and run a fortnightly design critique for the payments group.
Set up a quarterly usability benchmark with the research team so product changes are measured against a stable baseline.

education.degree: B.S. in Human Centered Design & Engineering
